listing.title: Universal BlackBook: Contacts
listing.shortDescription: A private address book: your own tags, every birthday, a note under each name.
fullDescription: A little black book for the people worth keeping up with: their numbers, their birthdays, and the thing you want to remember about them.

Most address books are built to sync a phone list. BlackBook is built for the note under the name: met at the Leeds conference, two kids, allergic to shellfish. It sits right below the name and number, and you can type straight into it from the person's page.
Birthdays, without the nagging
• A birthdays view, soonest first, with the age they are about to turn.
• The year is optional: "4 June, no idea what year" is a complete answer.
• Hide anyone from the countdown without losing their date.
• No reminders about who you haven't called. An address book, not a to-do list.
Filed your way
• Tags of your own, in seven colours, as many to a person as fit. Type a few letters and BlackBook finds the tag, or makes a new one.
• Search names, emails, numbers, notes and birthdays: pull down from the top of the list, and again for the keyboard.
• Pin the people you need most, hide the ones you rarely do, select several at once.
• Call, message, email or share a contact from their page.
• Add someone from your phone's own contacts, or bring in a spreadsheet.
Beside your people, if you want them
• Notes: a title and the details, newest first.
• To-do: things to do, with a deadline and your tags.
• Email lists: copy everyone's address in one go, or export the list.
Each is a switch in Tune this app, off until you turn it on.
Private by design

Your book lives on your phone and works with no account at all. Lock it with a PIN, and keep a copy in a backup file you can protect with a password. If you want the same book on your other devices, sign in with a Universal ID: it is encrypted on your phone with a passphrase only you know, so the copy we store is unreadable to us. No ads, no tracking, no selling anything about the people in it.
Paper by day, leather by night: Light, Dark, or whatever your phone is doing. In eight languages.
Universal BlackBook is open source (AGPL-3.0): github.com/universal-simulation-ltd/Universal_BlackBook
Bound by James Markey MBE and the UNI·SIM team.
